ai_city.perspective_disclaimer: Distance values are image-space proxies, normalised by frame diagonal.Perspective effects mean pixel distance does not linearly represent physical distance. Values are interpreted as relative behavioural indicators. Acknowledged as validity.
ai_city.image_plane_velocity_note: Velocity is computed in image-space (px/s), not world-space (m/s). Near-camera objects appear faster than far-background objects at the same physical speed. Values are relative behavioural indicators, not absolute km/h. Acknowledged as validity.

scientific_note: Cross-dataset velocity ratio is NOT enforced as a hard threshold. Different frame sizes and scene perspectives make direct vel_px_sec comparison between datasets inherently non-comparable. Validation is formula-correctness and epsilon-guard only. See thesis §3.8.2 for construct validity discussion.
